  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- Parameter entity comment --> <!ENTITY ent 'resolved-entity'>">
  %pe;
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY ext-img SYSTEM "data.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?target-pi data="processing instruction content &ent;"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Main document comment involving &ent; -->
  <ns2:child>
    <![CDATA[
      Nested CDATA block with unescaped markup <tags> & entities inside.
    ]]>
    &ent;
  </ns2:child>
</root>

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e_base "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY e_ref "&e_base; Extended">
  <!ENTITY % ext_dtd SYSTEM "http://localhost/nonexistent.dtd">
  %ext_dtd;
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<doc xmlns="http://xml.org/base" xmlns:sub="http://xml.org/sub">
  <!-- Section comment with CDATA ahead -->
  <sub:section>
    <![CDATA[CDATA section content #1]]>
    &e_ref;
  </sub:section>
  <section>
    <![CDATA[CDATA section content #2]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent-cdata "CDATA-like entity text">
  <!ENTITY % local_pe "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA | sub)*> <!ELEMENT sub EMPTY>">
  %local_pe;
]>
<?pi-target data="value"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://example.org/catalog" xmlns:x="http://example.org/x" xmlns:y="http://example.org/y">
  <!-- Comment containing entity reference &ent-cdata; -->
  <item>
    <![CDATA[
      <x:sub/> Data payload inside CDATA with attributes and namespaces.
    ]]>
  </item>
  <x:item>Value &ent-cdata;</x:item>
</catalog>
```

  %inner;
]>

<testsuite xmlns="http://ns.example.org/test" xmlns:t="http://ns.example.org/test">
  <!-- Comprehensive comment block with markup-like text <case> &ent2; -->
  <t:case>
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block spanning multiple lines.
      Entity reference check: &ent2;
    ]]>
  </t:case>
  <case>&ent2;</case>
</testsuite>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (content)*>
  <!ELEMENT content (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY reference "EntityContent">
  <!NOTATION gif SYSTEM "image/gif">
  <!ENTITY external SYSTEM "logo.gif" NDATA gif>
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ATTLIST content id ID #IMPLIED>">
  %macro;
]>
<?xml-debug trace="true"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.org/doc" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">
  <!-- Top level comment before CDATA and namespace usages -->
  <content id="c1" xlink:type="simple">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw data block inside CDATA: <content>&reference;</content>
    ]]>
  </content>
  <content id="c2">&reference;</content>
</document>
